content.json:
## AWS user activities
This workbook summarizes AWS CloudTrail user activity patterns for sign-ins, regions, identities, and user agents across the selected time range. Use the sections below to quickly spot failures, activity spikes, and suspicious identity behavior.

### Signin and login events
This section highlights AWS CloudTrail login activity, failures, and related breakdowns. Use it to identify sign-in spikes, suspicious patterns, and impacted users.

content.query:
AWSCloudTrail
| where EventName contains "Login"
| project TimeGenerated, UserIdentityArn, SourceIpAddress, LoginResult = tostring(parse_json(ResponseElements).ConsoleLogin), EventName, UserIdentityUserName
| where LoginResult != ""
| summarize count() by TimeGenerated, LoginResult, EventName, UserIdentityUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Sign-in events
content.noDataMessage: No data found for the selected time range and filters. Verify the data connector is enabled and data is flowing.

content.query:
let data = AWSCloudTrail
| where EventName contains "Login"
| extend LoginResult = tostring(parse_json(ResponseElements).ConsoleLogin)
| where LoginResult != "";
let appData = data
| summarize TotalCount = count() by LoginResult
| join kind=inner (data
    | make-series Trend = count() default = 0 on TimeGenerated in range({TimeRange:start}, {TimeRange:end}, {TimeRange:grain}) by LoginResult
    | project-away TimeGenerated) on LoginResult
| order by TotalCount desc, LoginResult asc
| project LoginResult, TotalCount, Trend
| serialize Id = row_number();
data
| summarize TotalCount = count() by EventName , LoginResult
| join kind=inner (data
    | make-series Trend = count() default = 0 on TimeGenerated in range({TimeRange:start}, {TimeRange:end}, {TimeRange:grain}) by LoginResult, EventName
    | project-away TimeGenerated) on LoginResult, EventName
| order by TotalCount desc, LoginResult asc
| project LoginResult, EventName, TotalCount, Trend
| serialize Id = row_number(1000000)
| join kind=inner (appData) on LoginResult
| project Id, Name = EventName, Type = 'EventName', ['LoginResults Count'] = TotalCount, Trend, ParentId = Id1
| union (appData 
    | project Id, Name = LoginResult, Type = 'LoginResult', ['LoginResults Count'] = TotalCount,  Trend)
| order by ['LoginResults Count'] desc, Name asc
content.title: Sign-in events results
content.noDataMessage: No sign-in event data was returned for the selected time range.

content.query:
AWSCloudTrail
| where EventName contains "login" or EventName contains "signin"
| extend Result = tostring(parse_json(ResponseElements).ConsoleLogin)
| where Result != ""
| summarize Success = sum(Result == "Success"), Failure = sum(Result == "Failure") by UserIdentityUserName, UserIdentityAccountId, SourceIpAddress, EventName
//| summarize NumberOfIPs = count() by UserIdentityUserName, UserIdentityAccountId, Success, Failure, EventName
| sort by Failure desc
content.title: User sign-ins, by failure rate, and IP addresses
content.noDataMessage: No sign-in result breakdown data was returned for the selected time range.

content.query:
AWSCloudTrail
| where EventName contains "login" or EventName contains "signin"
| summarize count() by Event = strcat(EventTypeName, ": ", EventName), bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Console and API signin events over time
content.noDataMessage: No sign-in failure data was returned for the selected time range.

content.query:
AWSCloudTrail
| where EventName contains "Login"
| where tostring(parse_json(ResponseElements).ConsoleLogin) == "Failure"
| summarize count() by UserIdentityUserName, UserIdentityArn, SourceIpAddress, ErrorMessage, UserAgent, AWSRegion,  TimeGenerated
content.title: Failed sign-ins
content.noDataMessage: No failed sign-in events were returned for the selected time range.

items.name: Failed sign-ins by user and source IP

content.json:
### Activities, by user types
This section compares AWS identity activity across account IDs, identity types, and related summary views. It helps analysts quickly narrow unusual activity by identity context.

content.query:
AWSCloudTrail
| where UserIdentityType == "IAMUser"
| summarize NumberOfEvents = count() by UserIdentityUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Active users
content.noDataMessage: No active user data was returned for the selected time range.

content.query:
AWSCloudTrail
| summarize NumberOfEvents = count() by UserIdentityAccountId , bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
| where UserIdentityAccountId != ""
content.title: Active account IDs
content.noDataMessage: No active account ID data was returned for the selected time range.

content.query:
AWSCloudTrail
| summarize count() by UserIdentityType, bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: User identity types
content.noDataMessage: No user identity type data was returned for the selected time range.

content.title: Summary
content.noDataMessage: No summary data was returned for the selected time range.

items.name: AWS activity summary by identity and event

content.query:
AWSCloudTrail
| where EventName == "GetCallerIdentity"
| where UserIdentityType == "AssumedRole" 
| summarize Count = count() by SourceIpAddress, UserIdentityAccountId, UserIdentityPrincipalid, AWSRegion, TimeGenerated
| sort by Count desc nulls last
content.title: Suspicious assumed-role account reconnaissance
content.noDataMessage: No assumed-role reconnaissance activity was returned for the selected time range.

content.json:
### Region activities
Use this section to spot geographic anomalies and regional trends in AWS activity. It is most useful when paired with the region filter and the regional trend visualization.

content.query:
let data = AWSCloudTrail;
let appData = data
| summarize TotalCount = count() by AWSRegion
| join kind=inner (data
    | make-series Trend = count() default = 0 on TimeGenerated in range({TimeRange:start}, {TimeRange:end}, {TimeRange:grain}) by AWSRegion
    | project-away TimeGenerated) on AWSRegion
| order by TotalCount desc, AWSRegion asc
| project AWSRegion, TotalCount, Trend
| serialize Id = row_number();
data
| summarize TotalCount = count() by EventName , AWSRegion
| join kind=inner (data
    | make-series Trend = count() default = 0 on TimeGenerated in range({TimeRange:start}, {TimeRange:end}, {TimeRange:grain}) by AWSRegion, EventName
    | project-away TimeGenerated) on AWSRegion, EventName
| order by TotalCount desc, AWSRegion asc
| project AWSRegion, EventName, TotalCount, Trend
| serialize Id = row_number(1000000)
| join kind=inner (appData) on AWSRegion
| project Id, Name = EventName, Type = 'EventName', ['AWSRegions Count'] = TotalCount, Trend,  ParentId = Id1
| union (appData 
    | project Id, Name = AWSRegion, Type = 'AWSRegion', ['AWSRegions Count'] = TotalCount,  Trend)
| order by ['AWSRegions Count'] desc, Name asc
content.title: Activities, by region - click to filter
content.noDataMessage: No regional activity data was returned for the selected time range.

content.query:
let details = dynamic({RegionFilter});
AWSCloudTrail
| where details.Type == "*" or (details.Type == "EventName" and details.Name == EventName) or (details.Type == "AWSRegion" and details.Name == AWSRegion)
| summarize count() by AWSRegion, bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Activities, by region over time
content.noDataMessage: No region trend data was returned for the selected time range.

content.json:
### User agent
This section groups AWS activity by user agent to help identify automation, scripts, or unusual client behavior. Review both the summary and trend views together.

content.query:
AWSCloudTrail
| summarize Count = count() by UserAgent
| order by Count
content.title: User agent activities - click to filter
content.noDataMessage: No user agent activity data was returned for the selected time range.

content.query:
AWSCloudTrail
| where '{UserAgent}' == UserAgent or '{UserAgent}' == "All"
| summarize Count = count() by UserAgent, TimeGenerated
content.title: User agent activities over time
content.noDataMessage: No user agent trend data was returned for the selected time range.
